about_the_game:
Overview

This adult RPG blends roguelike dungeon exploration with character growth mechanics.
You play as the witch Amelia, exploring a world full of danger and temptation while facing internal and external challenges.

You can freely adjust her growth path and choose event triggers to craft your unique adventure.
Will she stay rational or embrace trials and change? Her fate is in your hands.

Story

In the outskirts of the prosperous holy city of Crescent, rumors tell of a dungeon that’s never yielded returning investigators.
To uncover the truth, the powerful adventurer Amelia accepts the mission.

During her exploration, she encounters strange magical phenomena that begin to alter her body and mind.
As she travels between dungeon and town, Amelia faces unknown events and must make tough choices.

Characters

※Amelia

A calm, decisive witch adventurer skilled in ranged magic and strategic thinking.

She is the only character appearing in H-scenes, with all status and growth choices controlled by the player.

Roguelike Dungeon

The dungeon features roguelike random generation, offering new layouts, traps, and enemies each run.

  • Use ranged magic and items to handle surprises

  • Special effects or battle responses may trigger based on Amelia’s state

  • Trap events can be avoided or faced—player controls all trigger conditions

  • Abnormal conditions unlock richer interactions and story beats during exploration

Town & Systems

In town, players can:

  • Buy powerful staves and items

  • Take part-time jobs to boost stats or earn money

  • Trigger costume-based events (maid, dancer, bunny girl, bikini, etc.)

  • Observe NPC reactions change based on her outfit or gear

As Amelia’s state evolves, new town events unfold, enhancing exploration.

H Content

  • The game features various adult scenes that branch based on player behavior and Amelia’s state.

  • All scenes focus on interaction and strategy, supporting different playstyles.

  • Five unique endings offer replayability and route diversity.

*All in-game content is uncensored.*

short_description: The dungeon investigation team never returned. To uncover the truth, the powerful mage Amelia takes on the mission. Though she returns safely, strange changes begin to affect her body and mind. A quiet trial of transformation and choice now awaits.
supported_languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
